personality_one_liner: A calm, academic, and content-led reading experience that feels like a premium Italian architectural journal.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Let typography and whitespace carry the personality. Magazine-like rhythms.

dont's: Avoid glassmorphism entirely. It clashes with the Editorial aesthetic.
Use solid surfaceSecondary or brandTertiary for elevation.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard showing study streak, progress overview, and a daily goal to motivate the user.

states.empty: No progress yet. Show 'Inizia a studiare' (Start studying) primary CTA.
states.error: Failed to load progress. Show readable message with Retry button.

screens.layout: Hero card at the top featuring a terracotta architectural arch image (with gradient scrim to text). Below: structural sections for 'Obiettivo Quotidiano' (Daily Goal) and 'Continua a studiare' (Continue studying). Use full-width editorial sections with quiet dividers.

screens.name: Library (Studia)
screens.purpose: Topic library browsable by macro-argument (Urbanistica, Edilizia, Strutture, etc.) containing theory summary cards.
screens.layout: Magazine-style list with large serif headings. Each macro-argument is a clear, unboxed text section with generous padding. Tapping a topic opens the 'Theory Reader' screen which presents highly readable, article-like content with a sticky 'Mark as Completed' CTA.

screens.name: Practice (Esercitati)
screens.purpose: Central hub for Quiz mode, Flashcards, and Past Exam Themes (Tracce).
screens.layout: Segmented control (Quiz / Flashcards / Tracce) at the top. Flashcard mode uses large, full-screen swipeable cards with a 'flip' tap gesture. Quiz mode shows the question in large serif font, followed by clean sans-serif choice buttons. Immediate feedback state turns choice green/red and reveals an 'Explanation' block.

screens.name: AI Tutor
screens.purpose: Chat interface to ask questions about architectural topics and get grounded, contextual explanations.

states.empty: Initial greeting from AI Tutor with suggested prompts (e.g. 'Spiega le NTC 2018').
states.error: Message failed to send. Show retry icon.

screens.layout: Native, docked composer at the bottom. Full-width message stream with 16px side padding. AI responses are cleanly formatted with markdown support. No floating inputs. Chat history available via a top-right header icon.

screens.name: Progress (Statistiche)
screens.purpose: Detailed tracking of topics completed, quiz accuracy, weak areas, and mistakes review.

states.empty: No stats available. Prompt to take a quiz.

screens.layout: Data-heavy but editorial format. Large serif numbers for metrics (e.g., Accuracy %). A 'Mistakes Review' section listing past wrong answers that acts as a clickable list to view explanations.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT personality. Do not use SaaS-style floating cards or heavy shadows. Use flat, unboxed structural layouts with generous whitespace.
Use CormorantGaramond-Medium for headings and Satoshi-Regular for body text. Rely on font size for hierarchy, keeping weight capped at 500.
The primary brand color is Terracotta (#C05A46). Ensure strict avoidance of any blue/indigo/purple hues throughout the application.
Implement the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (Layer 0 image, Layer 1 linear gradient, Layer 2 text) for the home_hero image.
For the AI Tutor chat, dock the composer at the bottom and let the keyboard push the layout. Do not use a floating input that overlaps messages.
Ensure the Theory Reader screen emphasizes highly readable typography (line height 1.5x) and calm, restorative spacing to support long study sessions.
